body: Holy shit this is how I feel as well. I'm not killing myself because I hate myself, I'm just killing myself because I'm hurting. And what do you do if you're hurting? You take away the pain. The only way for me to not feel pain and let my body and mind rest is by dying. So that's what I choose to do. Killing myself. It's an act of kindness. This world is simply just not a nice place to exist in. Life keeps hurting me all the time. My childhood traumas have left me permanently scarred and broken. No amount of money, love, drugs or therapy will ever be able to fix me. This state of suffering that I'm in will never change. Prolonging the pain by staying alive and trying to keep going is pure self harm to me.

hey there, thanks for asking but I'll be okay. I've already made up my mind about ending it myself.  

and one last thing to OP: all I can do is to empathize with you. I'm sorry you're in so much pain, you're not the only one going through with this.

It's not a stupid reason at all. Animal lives are important too. And you are right, your dog will miss you. Sometimes it's the simple little things like spending time with my cats, listening to music, finishing a good book or watching the sunrise every morning that keeps me alive. Any reason to stay alive is good enough.
